name: NHS — dyspraxia in adults
description: An NHS information page about dyspraxia/developmental co-ordination disorder (DCD) in adults, including everyday effects, routes to assessment and examples of support at work or study.
intended_use: Start with current NHS information when adult movement or co-ordination difficulties may relate to dyspraxia/DCD and find the routes the NHS describes for further help.
audience_or_context: Adults in the UK looking for general NHS information about dyspraxia/DCD, and people supporting them.
limitations: The page is general health information and cannot diagnose an individual.
Assessment and therapy availability can depend on local services, and other causes need consideration when movement changes or worsens.
cost_or_access_notes: The NHS information page is publicly accessible; local NHS or private assessment routes can differ in availability and cost.
conflicts_of_interest: This is an NHS information route. ND Oracle records its current scope and access without replacing clinical assessment or treating the page as proof about an individual's symptoms.

provenance.method: NHS adult dyspraxia/DCD page, reviewed by the NHS on 30 March 2026, checked on 2026-08-28. Listing records the official information route and explicit assessment/local-service boundaries without adding a diagnosis claim.
